primary_mathematical_proof: The three actual row rectangles have widths3,2,1 and height1, so separate row perimeters sum8+6+4=18. Their two horizontal contact lengths are2 and1, each counted twice in that sum. The union perimeter is18-2*(2+1)=12. Equivalently horizontal exterior lengths telescope to6 and vertical exterior lengths sum6. Frozen offsets .75 and1 do not alter this. All six individual square boundaries stay present, no region or edge is added.
